summary: Bail appeals against acquittal; murder convictions under IPC 302/149, 147, 148, 120B; subsequent murder of police constable by Chandra Kumar and Rishi Kumar during trial; bail granted by HC based on incarceration period (10+ years) and parity; SC distinguishes parity due to separate murder case against Chandra/Rishi; SC dismisses appeal against Arvind Kumar's bail but cancels bail for Chandra Kumar and Rishi Kumar due to grave subsequent conduct; requirement to surrender within 14 days.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.147, s.148, s.302/149, s.120B
Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.302, s.201, s.120B, s.34, s.224
final_judgment: Appeal against Arvind Kumar dismissed; appeals against Chandra Kumar and Rishi Kumar allowed; bail of Chandra Kumar and Rishi Kumar cancelled; must surrender within two weeks or face coercive measures.
